SessionState.title: SessionState
SessionState.description: Live state of the PartnerUp UMKM interactive seminar session

activeQuestion.description: Current active worksheet question index (0 to 19)

activeSlide.description: Current active presentation slide index (0 to 29)

activeSlideStep.description: Current revealed PPT animation step index on the active slide (0 to 25)

stepByStepEnabled.description: Whether step-by-step PPT point animation is enabled

activeSlideDrawer.description: Overlay drawer currently displayed on the extended projector slide screen

allowParticipantSlideAccess.description: Whether participants can browse and download slide materials directly on their phones

answersLocked.description: Whether participant worksheet submissions are temporarily paused/locked by presenter

lockedNotice.description: Optional custom explanation note shown to participants when submissions are paused

activeMode.description: Current active interactive mode on participant phones and projector

activePollId.description: ID of the active live poll

moderationEnabled.description: If true, incoming answers and questions start as pending until approved by moderator

externalEmbedUrl.description: Optional external Slido or Mentimeter embed URL

sessionName.description: Title of the active seminar session

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of last state update in ms

CustomContentConfig.title: CustomContentConfig
CustomContentConfig.description: Dynamic editable seminar content: worksheet questions, slides, live polls, and Q&A topics

polls.description: Array of custom live polls and word clouds

qnaTopics.description: Array of custom Q&A topic tags

brandTheme.description: Custom organization brand color theme configuration

materialId.description: Unique identifier for this saved training material

description.description: Short description of the training material

category.description: Category or batch label for this training material

isDefault.description: Whether this is the core built-in curriculum

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description: Participant response to one of the worksheet questions

subText.description: Optional secondary field answer for structured prompts

star.description: Whether this answer is spotlighted on the projector

spotlightSize.description: Spotlight format style: besar (hero stage banner) or kecil (compact highlighted card)

mentorNote.description: Optional warm feedback note from presenter/moderator

QnaItem.title: QnaItem
QnaItem.description: Anonymous or named Q&A question with live upvoting (Slido style)

text.description: The question asked by the participant

authorName.description: Author or UMKM name, or Anonim

isAnonymous.description: Whether the question was submitted anonymously

star.description: Whether this question is currently highlighted on stage

PollVote.title: PollVote
PollVote.description: Participant vote on a live seminar poll or word cloud

FlipchartBoard.title: FlipchartBoard
FlipchartBoard.description: Live whiteboard/flipchart state synchronized between presenter remote tablet and projector/slide stage

isOpen.description: Whether the flipchart board is currently open

syncToProjector.description: Whether the active board should display on the main projector/slide screens

activePageIndex.description: Zero-based index of the currently active flipchart sheet

pagesJson.description: JSON-serialized array of FlipchartPage strokes and text annotations

sourceDeviceId.description: Device ID that last published an update

UnlockCampaign.title: UnlockCampaign
UnlockCampaign.description: Class unlock voting campaign configuration with candidate modules, schedule time slots, and minimum participant quota

title.description: Campaign headline shown to UMKM participants

subtitle.description: Campaign brief explanation and commitment instructions

minQuota.description: Minimum committed participants required to unlock the class (default 15)

candidateMaterialIds.description: Bounded list of material IDs included in this voting campaign

timeSlots.description: Bounded list of date and time option objects offered to participants

winningMaterialId.description: Material ID confirmed as the class winner

winningSlotId.description: Time slot ID confirmed as the class schedule

confirmedScheduleNote.description: Location, Zoom link, or H-1 confirmation note once class is scheduled

materialPricing.description: Map of materialId to paid/free pricing config (isPaid, price, originalPrice, paymentMode)

materialProgram.description: Map of materialId to 3-tier program classification (format: seminar|workshop|coaching, deliveryMode: online|offline, locationLabel, durationLabel, quotaOverride, coachingScope, targetCategory, prerequisiteNote)

qrisPayload.description: Static EMVCo QRIS merchant string used to generate dynamic amount QRIS codes

qrisMerchantName.description: Merchant display name printed on QRIS (e.g. OBEECREATIVES, DIGITAL & KREATIF)

qrisMerchantNmid.description: National Merchant ID (NMID) printed on the QRIS

qrisFallbackImageUrl.description: Static fallback QRIS image path or URL

mentorWhatsapp.description: Optional mentor WhatsApp number for payment confirmation messages

updatedAt.description: Last campaign update timestamp in ms

UnlockVote.title: UnlockVote
UnlockVote.description: Public participant commitment vote without PII (no phone/email)

availableSlotIds.description: All date/time slot IDs the participant can attend

flexibleTopic.description: Whether the participant is willing to attend even if another topic wins on their selected time slot

mainChallenge.description: Brief real problem or question the participant brings to class

paymentStatus.description: Class fee payment status (only admin can mark as paid)

paymentUniqueCode.description: Deterministic 2-3 digit unique payment suffix for matching GoPay Merchant mutations

paymentAmount.description: Total payable IDR amount including unique code

UnlockContact.title: UnlockContact
UnlockContact.description: Isolated PII contact and UMKM CRM lead record containing WhatsApp, Instagram, and mentor pipeline tracking, readable only by verified mentor/admin

whatsapp.description: Participant WhatsApp number for H-1 reminder and lead follow-up

interestedTopicId.description: Primary class topic ID voted by this UMKM lead

leadStage.description: CRM conversion funnel stage managed by mentor/admin

mentorNotes.description: Private mentor audit notes on Instagram feed and potential client services

paidAt.description: Timestamp in ms when verified as paid by mentor

/state/{sessionId}.description: Global seminar session state controlled by presenter/moderator

/custom_content/{docId}.description: Editable custom seminar questions, slides, polls, and Q&A topics

/answers/{answerId}.description: Participant worksheet answers across the seminar sections

/qna/{questionId}.description: Live Q&A questions with anonymous support and upvoting

/poll_votes/{voteId}.description: Live poll and word cloud votes

/flipchart/{boardId}.description: Live flipchart whiteboard sync between presenter remote tablet and projector/slide stage

/unlock_campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Class unlock voting campaign configurations and schedule options

/unlock_votes/{voteId}.description: Public participant topic & time slot commitment votes (zero PII)

/unlock_contacts/{contactId}.description: Admin-only WhatsApp contact details isolated from public voting feeds
